mapper.update: UPDATE bedrock_ai_chat_record SET total_prompt_tokens = total_prompt_tokens + #{promptTokens}, total_completion_tokens = total_completion_tokens + #{completionTokens}, total_tokens = total_tokens + #{totalTokens}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{recordId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.model_id AS modelId, m.model_name AS modelName, m.model, r.user_id, r.role_id AS roleId, ar.role_name AS roleName, ar.role_avatar AS roleAvatar, r.title, r.system_prompt AS systemPrompt, r.is_top AS isTop, r.chat_type, r.chat_options FROM bedrock_ai_chat_record r LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_model m ON r.model_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_role ar ON r.role_id = ar.id AND ar.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.model_id AS modelId, m.model_name AS modelName, m.model, r.user_id, COALESCE(ba.nickname, ba.username) AS nickname, r.role_id AS roleId, ar.role_name AS roleName, ar.role_avatar AS roleAvatar, r.title, r.chat_type AS chatType, r.system_prompt AS systemPrompt, r.is_top AS isTop, r.chat_options, r.total_prompt_tokens AS totalPromptTokens, r.total_completion_tokens AS totalCompletionTokens, r.total_tokens AS totalTokens, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM bedrock_ai_chat_record r LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_model m ON r.model_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_role ar ON r.role_id = ar.id AND ar.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_admin ba ON r.user_id = ba.id AND ba.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.id, r.model_id AS modelId, m.model_name AS modelName, r.role_id AS roleId, ar.role_name AS roleName, ar.role_avatar AS roleAvatar, r.title, r.chat_type AS chatType, r.is_top AS isTop, r.update_time AS updateTime FROM bedrock_ai_chat_record r LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_model m ON r.model_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bedrock_ai_role ar ON r.role_id = ar.id AND ar.is_deleted = 0 WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.chat_type = #{chatType} ORDER BY r.is_top DESC, r.update_time DESC
